correctness.rationale: Exact graph-face partition yields a simplicial cover by K, s cones on L, and the common one-skeleton. K is a wedge of A spheres in degree 2r-1, L is a wedge of B spheres in degree r-1, and dimension/connectivity nullhomotopy splits every cone. T is simply connected; each common edge adds an independent circle. Naturality of integral relative chains proves all three integral symmetry modules and block-swap signs. Nine full finite face-and-Lefschetz checks, including r=4, were replayed; finite computations corroborate, not replace, the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The natural missing corner of two complementary clique-book classifications yields nonabelian free groups of arbitrarily large rank and two simultaneously nonzero higher homology degrees. The result handles heterogeneous page sizes and complete integral automorphism modules for an unrestricted infinite family; it is not a known table recomputation or finite extrapolation. Its structure gives usable homotopy benchmarks for clique-avoidance complexes of chordal graphs with overlapping maximal cliques.
